items.reason: This is the adapalene gel you asked for, used at night to target the look of breakouts.
A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin clean without adding irritation alongside adapalene.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the look of comfortable, hydrated skin, since your moisture score is on the lower side.
Daily mineral SPF is important because adapalene can make skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Morning: cleanse, moisturize, then apply sunscreen. At night, cleanse, apply a thin layer of adapalene to dry skin every other night at first, then moisturize; skip other exfoliating acids or retinol products while you start.
